title: Digitalization Strategy for Local Planning
short_desc: An internship business case at the LEGO Group. It looked at how to replace many separate Excel sheets in local planning with one shared planning tool.
problem: Local planning was done in many different Excel sheets. Each planner worked in their own way, and much of the knowledge was in people's heads.
built: I interviewed 7 local planners and mapped how planning was done in practice. I wrote a 60-page business proposal with the economics, the business case, user requirements and recommendations. I also built a rapid prototype in Power Apps, wrote a one-page brief for leadership and presented it to management.
result: The LEGO Group later approved Kinaxis Maestro as a unified planning tool, a need my analysis helped document.
tech_notes: Method: interviews with 7 local planners, a map of the current planning process across their Excel sheets, a rapid Power Apps prototype to test a shared way of working, and a 60-page business proposal covering economics, business case, user requirements and recommendations. The findings were condensed into a one-page brief and presented to management.
role: Engineering intern, the LEGO Group (Mould Engineering Prototypes)
